hints.title: Reverse Event Time
hints.text: Reversing the sequence of brick removals transforms the problem into incrementally adding bricks back.

hints.title: Top Row Roof Component
hints.text: Create a virtual ceiling node that connects to all stable bricks in row zero.

hints.title: Incremental Connectivity Count
hints.text: Erase all hit bricks first, build disjoint sets, then add hit bricks backwards. The increase in roof component size minus one gives the count of falling bricks.

complexity.notes: Reverse time union-find with virtual ceiling supernode.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing connected components after each removal takes O(H * R * C) time, leading to timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Parent and size arrays require O(R * C) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model stability via virtual roof node and process queries in reverse order.
